name: Gatsby Blog Platform
overview: Designed and built a production publishing platform for HexaHome that enabled non-technical teams to create, manage, and publish SEO-optimized content independently. The platform streamlined editorial workflows, improved developer experience through automation, and became a major acquisition channel, contributing 70% of the company's website traffic through organic search.
challenge: Building a scalable publishing platform that balanced editor usability, developer workflows, SEO optimization, and deployment automation while supporting long-term content growth without increasing engineering overhead.
projectDetails: Architected and developed a Gatsby-based publishing platform from the ground up.
Designed a custom Markdown editor with autosave to improve the editorial workflow.
Engineered a Git-based publishing pipeline enabling structured content management and version control.
Optimized static generation, image processing, caching, and build performance for fast page delivery.
Implemented SEO-focused architecture to improve indexing, discoverability, and organic search visibility.
Automated deployment workflows to simplify publishing and reduce operational overhead.
Contributed to 70% of the company's website traffic through improved organic search performance.

name: Authoritative Multiplayer Tic-Tac-Toe
overview: Built a server-authoritative multiplayer game using Nakama to explore distributed systems, authoritative game servers, and realtime synchronization. Every gameplay action is validated on the server, ensuring fair gameplay while maintaining a responsive multiplayer experience.
challenge: Designing a server-authoritative multiplayer architecture that maintained realtime synchronization, handled unreliable network conditions, and ensured gameplay integrity without sacrificing responsiveness.
projectDetails: Engineered server-authoritative gameplay with all game logic executed and validated on the Nakama server.
Implemented matchmaking, match lifecycle management, and realtime state synchronization.
Designed reliable player connection handling including joins, disconnects, reconnections, and match recovery.
Integrated the React frontend with the Nakama client SDK for seamless multiplayer interactions.
Implemented deterministic move validation to prevent invalid or conflicting game states.
Containerized and deployed the backend using Docker while leveraging Railway for hosting.
Designed a scalable multiplayer architecture following modern distributed game server practices.

name: iSee – Video Calling Platform
overview: Developed a realtime peer-to-peer communication platform focused on instant collaboration without requiring user registration. The application demonstrates realtime media streaming, signaling, session management, and responsive communication workflows.
challenge: Building a reliable realtime communication platform that simplified peer connection setup while maintaining low-latency video streaming, session stability, and a frictionless user experience.
projectDetails: Built realtime peer-to-peer video communication using WebRTC.
Implemented Socket.io signaling for session negotiation and connection management.
Designed instant room creation and unique session codes without requiring user accounts.
Developed integrated realtime messaging alongside live video communication.
Implemented connection lifecycle handling to improve session stability and user experience.
Built a responsive interface optimized for desktop and mobile devices using React and Tailwind CSS.

name: JustSocial – Social Media Platform
overview: Built a full-stack social networking platform supporting realtime communication, content sharing, profile management, and community engagement. The project demonstrates end-to-end product engineering across frontend, backend, authentication, and realtime systems.
challenge: Designing a scalable social platform that combined realtime messaging, dynamic content feeds, user relationships, and secure authentication into a cohesive product experience.
projectDetails: Engineered a production-style full-stack application using React, Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB.
Implemented realtime messaging and notifications using WebSockets.
Built dynamic content feeds supporting posts, comments, likes, and user interactions.
Designed user relationship management including friend requests, connections, and profile management.
Implemented authentication, authorization, and secure session handling.
Developed responsive, accessible user interfaces with Material UI across desktop and mobile devices.
Structured the application to support scalable feature development and maintainable code organization.
